angle: Post-launch condo opportunities for high returns
body_text:
If you're only looking at new launches in 2026, you might be missing out 👇

Most homeowners are told the same thing:

“Wait for the next new launch.”

But sometimes the real opportunity appears after the launch instead.

Recently, our team positioned six of our clients into the same development, and within about a year they’re already seeing around $300K–$400K in gains.

And no — they didn’t enter during launch.

They entered post-launch, when some remaining units were still undervalued within the development.

The catch?

Post-launch opportunities usually involve remaining units, so availability is limited.

Once those units are taken, the opportunity is usually gone.

Here’s what this approach has achieved so far:

✅ 19.56% average annualised returns
✅ 800+ homeowners successfully upgraded
✅ $300K–$500K potential gains per upgrade cycle
✅ 7 out of 10 homes sold at record prices

And don’t worry if you’ve missed this particular development.

Our team has already identified several other properties with similar potential.

👉 If your property has already met its MOP or SSD, feel free to book a Property Planning Session below.

During the session, we’ll explore whether any of these opportunities make sense for your situation.

headline: Get Our List of Condo Upgrade Opportunities ✅
transcript_text: New launch, new launch, new launch. That's what almost every agent sound like. But have you heard of post-launch? Here's what most upgraders don't realize. When everyone rushes into a project during launch, that's usually when all the attention is concentrated in one place, like overhyped projects with high entry prices like Zion Grand, Sky at Holland, and River Morton. But sometimes, that interesting opportunity appears later, after the launch phase, what we call post-launch units. Recently, our team positioned six of our clients into one of these developments, and within about a year, they're seeing around $300,000 to $400,000 in gains. After helping 814 homeowners upgrade their properties, we've built a process around identifying these rare opportunities, and we've already identified several other developments with similar potential. If you have cleared your MOP or SST and are planning to upgrade now, feel free to reach out for a property planning session, and we can explore whether any of these opportunities make sense for you.
